metadata.case_name: MA CHUNG LUNG v. YAO POON TONG

injuries.description: Moderate multi-level degeneration of the cervical spine, with multiple disc herniations, osteophytes and varying degrees of spinal stenosis and neural foraminal compromise as shown on MRI.
source:
1. ……
2. In C2/3, small central herniation. Borderline spinal canal.
3. In C3/4, small central herniation. Mild spinal stenosis. The right C3/4 neural foramen is mildly compromised by uncinate process hypertrophy.
4. In C4/5, large left sided posterior osteophyte. Mild spinal stenosis. The left C4/5 neural foramen is moderately compromised by the posterior osteophyte, uncinate process hypertrophy and facet degeneration. The right C4/5 neural foramen is mildly compromised by the facet degeneration.
5. In C5/6, a large posterior osteophyte with left sided eccentricity. Moderate spinal stenosis. Both C5/6 neural foramina are markedly comprised bilaterally by the posterior osteophyte and uncinate process hypertrophy.
6. In C6/7, a medium size posterior osteophyte with left sided eccentricity. Mild spinal stenosis. The left C6/7 neural foramen is markedly compromised by the posterior osteophyte and uncinate process hypertrophy.

injuries.description: Soft tissue injuries with tenderness over right scalp, left anterior chest wall, left neck and lumbar spine; no fractures detected on X-ray.
injuries.body_part: right scalp; left anterior chest wall; left neck; lumbar spine
source:
2. On examination, the following conditions were found:
I) Tenderness over right scalp.
II) Tenderness of left anterior chest wall.
III) Tenderness of left neck.
IV) Tenderness over lumbar spine.
V) No neurological deficit.
VI) Skull, cervical spine, lumbar spine, chest and left hand X-ray did not reveal any fracture.
3. He was treated and transferred to orthopedics ward, PYNEH.

manifestations.description: Tenderness over posterior neck region and left lower chest region
Decreased range of motion of neck, especially on extension; limitation in right rotation and lateral flexions (active range of motion)
Decreased 50% pinprick sensation over right C5 to C8 dermatone and left C7 to C8 dermatone
Right upper limb weakness; reduced isometric steering wheel strength on right (6lbs clockwise, 5lbs counter-clockwise) about 75% to 63% of left upper limb
Residual neck pain and limited neck rotation interfering with ability to resume work as a taxi driver (as complained)

treatments_received: admission and transfer to orthopedics ward, PYNEH
physiotherapy (heat therapy, intermittent neck traction, neck exercises, advice on neck care) - 12 sessions mentioned
magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of cervical spine

losses.description: Minor injury to head and left upper body with neck symptoms and cervical degeneration triggered by the accident; pain and restricted neck movement.
